title.zh: 宇宙膨胀 · 哈勃定律

description.zh: 不是星系在静止的空间里从一个中心飞散，而是空间的刻度本身在拉开：所有星系间的距离按同一个尺度因子变大，所以越远的星系退行得越快（v = H₀d），它们发出的光在路上也被拉长成红移。
description.en: Galaxies are not flying apart from a centre through still space; the ruler of space itself is stretching: every distance between galaxies grows by the same scale factor, so farther galaxies recede faster (v = H₀d), and their light is stretched into a redshift on the way.

aliases.en: does the universe have a centre

aliases.zh: 星系为什么在远离我们
aliases.en: why are galaxies moving away from us

label.zh: H₀ 是一条直线的斜率
label.en: H₀ is the slope of a line

reason.zh: 把星系的退行速度对距离作图，近处的点落在一条过原点的直线上，斜率就是哈勃常数 H₀。
reason.en: Plot galaxies’ recession speed against distance and the nearby points fall on a straight line through the origin whose slope is the Hubble constant H₀.

label.en: Both are redshifts, for different reasons

reason.zh: 多普勒红移来自光源在空间中远离；宇宙学红移是光在路上随空间一起被拉长，λ观测 = (1+z)λ₀ 由发光到接收之间尺度因子增大了多少决定——近处两者数值相近，远处不能混用。
reason.en: A Doppler redshift comes from a source moving away through space; a cosmological redshift is light stretched along with space on its journey, λ_obs = (1+z)λ₀ set by how much the scale factor grew between emission and reception — close by the numbers agree, far away they must not be mixed up.
